name: Songo kit with clave anchor
desc: Cuban songo groove: a son clave 3-2 rimshot anchor alternates its two bars via angle-brackets while uzu toms voiced as congas walk a 5-note polymeric tumbao that drifts against the 8th grid. Syncopated bombo kick, backbeat snare, pumped cascara hats and a mambo cowbell in the peak.

code.sparse: stack(s("rim").struct("<[x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~] [~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ ~]>").gain(${gain}*.55).room(.25), s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~").gain(${gain}).shape(.2), s("mt(3,8,<0 2>)").speed(${spd}).gain(${gain}*.5).shape(.1).pan(.42)).orbit(1).play()
code.full: stack(s("rim").struct("<[x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~] [~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ ~]>").gain(${gain}*.55).room(.25), s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~").gain(${gain}).shape(.2), s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").gain(${gain}*.5).room(.2), s("{mt lt ht lt mt}%8").speed(${spd}).gain("[.5 .3 .4 .3]*2").shape(.15).pan(sine.range(.35, .55).slow(16)), s("[hh hh]*4").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.25, ${gain}*.45).fast(4)).hpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*1.6).slow(16))).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("rim").struct("<[x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~] [~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ ~]>").gain(${gain}*.55).room(.25), s("bd ~ ~ ~ [~ bd] ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~").gain(${gain}).shape(.25), s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").gain(${gain}*.55).room(.2), s("{mt lt ht lt mt ht lt}%8").speed(${spd}).gain("[.55 .35 .45 .35]*2").shape(.2).pan(sine.range(.3, .6).slow(12)), s("cb*2").gain(${gain}*.35).pan(.6), s("[hh hh]*4").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.3, ${gain}*.5).fast(4)).hpf(${cut}*1.3)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
